"""Python ports of sentinel.go's finders, used to predict every assertion in
corpus_test.go before a fixture is committed.

The point is not to re-test the parser — it is to refuse to commit a fixture the
suite would go red on, without touching a single .go file.
"""
import re
from census import normalise, HDRKEY, unbold, ATTR, WRAPPED, FWD, census

OPENERS = ["on","le","el","il","em","am","op","den","på","pe","w dniu","dnia","vào","在"]
CLOSERS = ["wrote:","sent:","a écrit :","a écrit:","écrit:","escribió:","ha scritto:",
           "scritto:","escreveu:","schrieb:","schreef:","napisał:","napisała:","pisze:",
           "skrev:","kirjoitti:","đã viết:","写道：","작성:"]
MAXWRAP = 5

def starts_with_opener(t):
    l = t.strip().lower()
    return any(l == o or l.startswith(o + " ") or l.startswith(o + " ") for o in OPENERS)

def has_closer(t):
    l = t.lower()
    return any(c in l for c in CLOSERS)

def find_attribution(lines, i):
    if i >= len(lines) or not starts_with_opener(lines[i][0]):
        return None
    parts = []
    for j in range(i, min(len(lines), i + MAXWRAP + 1)):
        t = lines[j][0].strip()
        if t == "" and j > i:
            break
        if j > i and starts_with_opener(t):
            break
        parts.append(t)
        if has_closer(" ".join(parts)):
            return (i, j + 1, lines[i][1])
    return None

def find_header_block(lines, i):
    j = i
    n = 0
    while j < len(lines):
        t = unbold(lines[j][0].strip())
        if t == "" or not HDRKEY.match(t):
            break
        n += 1
        j += 1
    return (i, j) if n >= 2 else None

def problems(body, stats):
    """Every corpus_test.go assertion, as a list of human-readable failures."""
    bad = []
    c = census(body)
    for k in ("attr", "wrapped", "fwd"):
        if c[k] != stats[k]:
            bad.append(f"{k} census drift: body {c[k]} vs stats {stats[k]}")
    lines = normalise(body)
    md = max((d for _, d in lines), default=0)
    if md != stats["max_depth"]:
        bad.append(f"max_depth {md} vs stats {stats['max_depth']}")
    found = nested = 0
    for i in range(len(lines)):
        b = find_attribution(lines, i)
        if b:
            found += 1
            if b[2] > 0:
                nested += 1
    if found < stats["attr"]:
        bad.append(f"found {found} attributions below floor {stats['attr']}")
    if stats["wrapped"] > 0 and found <= stats["attr"]:
        bad.append(f"wrapped {stats['wrapped']} but found {found} <= floor {stats['attr']}")
    blocks = keys = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        b = find_header_block(lines, i)
        if b:
            blocks += 1
            keys += b[1] - b[0]
            i = b[1]
            continue
        i += 1
    if stats["hdr"] >= 4 and blocks == 0:
        bad.append(f"hdr {stats['hdr']} but no header block found")
    if keys > stats["hdr"]:
        bad.append(f"claimed {keys} header lines, census counted {stats['hdr']}")
    for i, (t, _) in enumerate(lines):
        if "\r" in t:
            bad.append(f"line {i} carries a CR")
            break
    return bad, nested
